name: Solo Website System (SWS)
postCreateCommand: bash -lc 'rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown && rustup component add clippy && cargo install worker-build@^0.9 --locked && cargo install cargo-deny --locked && export NVM_DIR="${NVM_DIR:-/usr/local/share/nvm}" && [ -s "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" ] && NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; if [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ]; then . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && nvm install --lts && nvm use --lts; fi && (command -v pnpm >/dev/null 2>&1 || (corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@latest --activate) || npm install -g pnpm) && npx playwright install --with-deps chromium'
